## motion_project

Create/list/open durable profile-local projects, inspect status and update revisioned content atomically. Create requires a UUID request_id; updates require the current expected_revision and a new request_id. Use returned project IDs explicitly; open does not set an implicit current project. Project operations do not render media or authorize execution.

## motion_capabilities

Discover/list/inspect installed adapter declarations, operation schemas, dependencies and availability without executing engines or models. Inspect a selected adapter before binding or compiling work; availability is not permission, proof of successful media execution or universal support. host_readiness measures the backend host and selected paths/adapter requirements without starting work; it is not a resource reservation or remote-client proof. task_overview pages existing job statuses and failed/blocked/stale counts for one project without renewing leases or launching work. setup_report passively inspects this plugin bundle and declared dependency presence without executing engines, installing packs or overriding scanner findings. topology_check validates declared Desktop locations/addresses, not reachability. tool_readiness reports cached typed mapping/provider gaps, not execution readiness.

## motion_asset

Import exact authorized local file bytes into a project, or reference external local bytes without taking ownership; list/get registered assets. Use canonical absolute regular-file paths and preserve returned IDs/hashes. Probe compiles media.probe and submits an owned job using the selected adapter, expected_revision and UUID request_id; collect/inspect the job before treating metadata as verified. No remote acquisition is performed.

## motion_asset_library

Get/update a project asset inventory, requirements, missing material and assessments before storyboarding. Update takes the complete value, expected_revision and UUID request_id; get/view may select a historical revision. View writes a self-contained HTML asset sheet, not a live editor. No external assets are acquired.

## motion_storyboard

Get/update ordered visual panels, timing, narration, motion, transitions and feedback. Requires a committed assessed asset library and registered image for every panel. Update takes the complete value, expected_revision and UUID request_id. View exports HTML; edit through update, not the view. Library changes can make a board stale; ready is agent readiness, not user approval.

## motion_plan

Compile immutable capability-bound plans from explicit project revisions and inspect their nodes, effects, gaps and verified manifest handles. Resolve unsupported bindings before submission. Compile/inspect does not execute, approve data upload or grant spend authority. Recompile after changing content or installed bindings; existing plans do not refresh. Creative actions retain editable script and user delegation; editorial actions retain source-linked extract selections, selective reconform and deliverable gaps. ETA uses explicit remaining scope and measured job evidence, never a promised finish time. Metadata selection/estimation does not start production.

## motion_run

Submit/list/inspect durable owned jobs, cancel/reconcile attempts and claim/collect typed native handoffs. Submit requires the exact plan pin, expected_revision and UUID request_id plus existing runtime authority. A claim or successful host call is not collected output: validate receipts and status. Unknown authority fails closed; never invent approval or receipt fields.

## motion_caption

Transcribe/align through connected execution routes; adopt/get/correct/style canonical captions and request timing review, raster preview or export. ## motion_review

Request deterministic checks, record/list/inspect exact-candidate reviews and inspect release gates. Reviews bind actual bytes and revisions; runtime provenance determines actor authority, not a caller claiming to be the user. Inspect gate results before promotion. Metadata presence does not establish visual/audio quality or personal acceptance.

## motion_deliver

Encode/validate delivery candidates through explicit jobs, inspect status, promote already checked exact bytes, retrieve delivery file records and build/revalidate supported editable packages.
